data.cultural_impact: The name 'Shrishti' holds a deep cultural significance in Hinduism. It is considered as the creative force or the power that brings things into existence. The name embodies the belief in the divine power that permeates the universe and is responsible for the creation of all things.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Shrishti represents the divine Mother, who is the source of all creation. It signifies the understanding that everything in the universe, including ourselves, is a manifestation of a higher power or divine will. The name serves as a reminder of our interconnectedness with the divine and encourages us to align our actions with the divine purpose.
